# Note types

Every note has `type:` set to one of the types below; there are no others. Variation within a type goes in a subtype field (`document-type:`), not in a new type. A new note starts from its type's template, goes in its type's home when it has one, and has every required key filled. Links are written as `"[[Note name]]"`.

## Context

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Context.md`
- `area`: text
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Project

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Project.md`
- Required: `context`
- `context`: a link to a Context note
- `status`: one of Active, Blocked, Quiet, Paused, Closed
- `phase`: text
- `next`: text
- `index`: text
- `last`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD
- `people`: a list of links to Person notes

## Meeting

- Home: `Calendar/Meetings/{yyyy}/`, `{yyyy}` the note's year
- Template: `Resources/Templates/Meeting.md`
- Required: `context`
- `context`: a link to a Context note
- `about`: a link to a Project or Context note
- `with`: a list of links to Person notes
- `date`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD
- `language`: text
- `one-liner`: text
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Person

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Person.md`
- `context`: a link to a Context note
- `about`: a link to a Project note
- `role`: text
- `company`: text
- `email`: text

## Document

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Document.md`
- Required: `context`
- `context`: a link to a Context note
- `about`: a link to a Project or Context note
- `document-type`: text
- `document-status`: text
- `archive`: true or false
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Thread

- Home: `Calendar/Threads/{yyyy}/`, `{yyyy}` the note's year
- Template: `Resources/Templates/Thread.md`
- Required: `context`
- `context`: a link to a Context note
- `about`: a link to a Project or Context note
- `with`: a list of links to Person notes
- `period`: text
- `one-liner`: text
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Daily

- Home: `Calendar/Daily/{yyyy}/`, `{yyyy}` the note's year
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Journal

- Home: `Calendar/Daily/{yyyy}/`, `{yyyy}` the note's year
- `created`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD

## Transcript

- Home: `Calendar/Meetings/{yyyy}/`, `{yyyy}` the note's year
- `meeting`: a link to a Meeting note

## Reference

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Reference.md`
- `source-url`: text
- `source-author`: text
- `source-date`: a date, YYYY-MM-DD
- `context`: a link to a Context note

## Framework

- Template: `Resources/Templates/Framework.md`
- `domain`: text
- `source`: text
